Передача на вертолёте

Operation involving the embarkation or disembarkation of personnel or cargo by helicopter to or from a vessel, requiring special procedures and communications.

Questions and answers

What is Передача на вертолёте?

In this glossary, Передача на вертолёте refers to: Operation involving the embarkation or disembarkation of personnel or cargo by helicopter to or from a vessel, requiring special procedures and communications.

How is Передача на вертолёте used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Мостик, подготовить кормовую палубу для передачи на вертолёте в 08:00 UTC. Очистить посадочную площадку и проинструктировать экипаж."

Definition

Operation involving the embarkation or disembarkation of personnel or cargo by helicopter to or from a vessel, requiring special procedures and communications.

Operational example

Bridge, prepare for helicopter transfer on aft deck at 0800 UTC. Clear landing area and brief crew on procedures.
